name: baketorio-retexture
title: Baketorio Retexture
author: ButteredCoffee
description:
New graphics for Baketorio: HD salt and trona ores, and a large 3D glass greenhouse (5x7) that shows the crop it is growing and how much harvest is waiting.

Note: the greenhouse becomes 5x7 tiles with this mod. Adding or removing it in an existing save resizes placed greenhouses.
